spec_case: issue #778 step 7 (the http tool refuses any scheme other than http/https before any I/O, and a curl-based adapter refuses the same way for its own base_url)
description: ftp://, file:///<a real file in this case directory>, and data: are each refused before any I/O, absorbed by on_error: continue. The file:// case proves no local file was ever read: secret.txt carries a distinctive marker that never appears anywhere in the captured state, and the error text is the scheme-refusal message, never a file-read error. The fourth effect's own adapter base_url names ftp://, refused the same way through the shared curl choke point.
